notes: The GT dataset contains only fresh yield (CtrlFreshYield, TreatmentFreshYield) as the primary outcome, but extraction data contains many outcome types (yield, biomass, quality traits, etc.).
GT yield values appear to be in t/ha or kg/m2 scale (range ~0.2-4.2 for most rows), while extraction data contains values in many units.
The 'replicates' column in GT is used for both control and treatment n since the GT does not have separate n columns.
Some paper_ids in extraction may map to the same GT study (e.g., multiple papers for grape/Popescu).
The GT TreatmentFreshYield values are in the range 0.2-4.2 for most entries, suggesting t/ha or similar units.
Extraction data contains non-yield outcomes (quality, morphology, biochemistry) that must be excluded.
Unit conversion will be needed for papers where extraction reports kg/ha but GT stores t/ha.
The 'pair' column in GT likely identifies individual treatment-control pairs within a study.
ContinusStudy column in GT (0,1,2,3) may indicate repeated/continuous study years.
Some extraction paper_ids could not be confidently matched to GT studies due to ambiguous author/year combinations.
The GT CtrlFreshYieldSD and TreatmentFreshYieldSD appear to be standard deviations already computed.
For papers with multiple outcomes in extraction, only yield-related observations should be matched to GT.
